data_description.name: The name of this remote in Home Assistant. Leave it empty to keep the current name.

abort.discovery_only: Manual setup is not supported. The device must be discovered automatically via mDNS.
abort.already_provisioned_elsewhere: Device is already connected to another Home Assistant.

data_description.optimistic_updates: Update button icons immediately on press, before confirming the actual state. If the action fails, the icon reverts to the real state shortly after.
data_description.language: Language for the button labels this remote displays. "Automatic" follows Home Assistant's language.

demo.name: Demo Mode
demo.description: Saving sends Device.Control.DemoMode to the device. The timings are optional — leave them empty to keep the device's own.

data_description.demo_mode: Toggle the device's demo mode. Saving options sends Device.Control.DemoMode to the device.
data_description.demo_mode_dwell_time: Optional DemoMode DwellTime value sent to Device.Control.
data_description.demo_mode_swipe_time: Optional DemoMode SwipeTime value sent to Device.Control.

sliders.name: Slider Options
sliders.description: A slider reports continuously while it is being touched, and the device cannot be asked to send less. This limit thins that stream. Touch and release are always acted on immediately, so the start of a drag and the final position are never delayed. Set it to 0 to act on every change.

data_description.slider_min_interval_ms: Shortest gap between two updates while a slider is being dragged. Touch and release are always sent immediately, so the start and the final position are never delayed. 0 disables the limit.

firmware_update.name: Firmware Update
firmware_update.description: Trigger an OTA firmware update on one or more lizaIP devices. The device downloads and verifies the firmware, then reboots; the connection drops and reconnects automatically.

url.name: Firmware URL
url.description: HTTPS URL of the firmware binary (.bin file). When using the Update entity's Install button this is resolved automatically from the latest GitHub release.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: Config entry of the device to update. If omitted, all connected devices are updated.

launch_app.name: Launch app
launch_app.description: Start an app on a TV. A Samsung TV is started over its own API, because it ignores the launch Home Assistant's Samsung integration sends; any other player gets media_player.play_media.

entity_id.name: TV
entity_id.description: The media players to start the app on.

app_id.name: App
app_id.description: The app's id on that TV, e.g. 3201907018807 for Netflix on a Samsung TV.

refresh_dynamic_sources.name: Refresh dynamic sources
refresh_dynamic_sources.description: Re-resolve dynamic template bindings and push any changes to the affected remotes. Pages whose content did not change produce no device traffic.

entry_id.name: Device
entry_id.description: Device to refresh. If omitted, all lizaIP devices are refreshed.

goto_page.name: goto page
goto_page.description: Show a page on the remote. On a button this becomes a device-local action the remote executes itself.

page_id.name: Page ID
page_id.description: The numeric id of the page to show, as listed in the lizaIP panel.

send_ir.name: Send IR code
send_ir.description: Have a lizaIP remote transmit an infrared code, given either as an IR code or as a key of an IR device.

via.name: Via lizaIP
via.description: The remote that transmits the key.

entity_id.name: IR key
entity_id.description: The key of an IR device to send.

ir_blob.name: IR code
ir_blob.description: The infrared code to transmit, base64 encoded.

no_firmware_url.message: No firmware download URL available. Check that the latest GitHub release has a .bin asset.

unknown_firmware_version.message: The firmware server has no version "{version}".

device_ip_unknown.message: The device IP address is not known. Make sure the device is connected.

device_port_unknown.message: The device HTTP port is not known. The device has not completed its handshake yet.

ota_unreachable.message: Could not reach the device update endpoint at {url}: {error}

ota_rejected.message: The device rejected the update request (HTTP {status}): {error}

control_unreachable.message: Could not reach the device control endpoint at {url}: {error}

control_rejected.message: The device rejected the control request (HTTP {status}): {error}

invalid_page_id.message: Invalid page ID "{page_id}". It must be an integer between 1 and 4294967295.

no_pages.message: The lizaIP device has no page configuration yet.

no_page_target.message: No page given. Set Page, or give a name in Page name.

unknown_page_name.message: There is no page called "{page}" on this device.

ambiguous_page_name.message: {count} pages are called "{page}" on this device. Set Page to say which one.

conflicting_page_target.message: The name "{page}" belongs to page {resolved}, not page {page_id}. Give one or the other, not both.

invalid_ir_blob.message: The IR code is not valid base64.

ir_send_refused.message: The remote refused the infrared code: {error}

ir_remote_ambiguous.message: More than one lizaIP is connected, so it is unclear which one sends the key. Press the key from a lizaIP button, or use the Send IR device key action and choose the lizaIP.

ir_catalog_unavailable.message: The IR code could not be loaded: {error}

not_a_remote.message: The chosen device is not a lizaIP remote.

ir_entry_missing.message: The IR devices entry does not exist yet.

refresh_failed.message: Refreshing the dynamic sources failed for: {devices}

address_locked.title: {name} cannot take Home Assistant's new address
address_locked.description:
The remote is set to reach Home Assistant at `{held}`, which no longer works, and Home Assistant is now at `{wanted}`. The remote refuses a different hostname to protect itself from being taken over, so it cannot be updated from here.

Factory-reset the remote (hold POWER and button 9 for more than 3 seconds) and pair it again.

address_stale.title: {name} will lose Home Assistant at its next restart
address_stale.description:
The remote is set to reach Home Assistant at `{held}`. That name now resolves to {resolved}, not to this Home Assistant ({own}); the remote is still connected only because it remembers the old address.

Give this Home Assistant host its old name back, or factory-reset the remote (hold POWER and button 9 for more than 3 seconds) and pair it again. The remote changes a stored hostname only after a factory reset.

protocol_mismatch.title: {name} speaks a different protocol version
protocol_mismatch.description: The remote speaks lizaIP protocol version {device}, Home Assistant speaks version {ha}. Some features may not work. Update the remote's firmware or the lizaIP integration so both match.

user.title: Add an IR device
user.description: Pick the brand of a television and name the device, or leave the name to take the brand.

data_description.brand_id: Manufacturer of the TV. Its IR codes come from the catalogue.
data_description.name: Shown as the device name. Leave it empty to use the brand.

data_description.code_set_id: If the TV does not react to the keys, try another code set.

error.ir_unknown_brand: There is no brand of that name. Pick one from the list.

abort.ir_catalog_unavailable: The IR code catalogue cannot be reached. Try again later.
abort.ir_catalog_no_key: The IR code catalogue has no key for this remote model. Try again later.
abort.ir_no_keys: The catalogue has no code set for this brand with a key the remote can send.
